title: Google launches Gemini 4 Hydrogen, calling it a major upgrade over Gemini 3.8 Flash, at $1.50/1M input and $7.50/1M output tokens across its 1M context window (Koray Kavukcuoglu/Google)
summary: Koray Kavukcuoglu / Google: Google launches Gemini 4 Hydrogen, calling it a major upgrade over Gemini 3.8 Flash, at $1.50/1M input and $7.50/1M output tokens across its 1M context window — Hydrogen brings cutting-edge intelligence to everyone. — SVP, Google DeepMind and Chief AI Architect, Google
